pages.text: A VARIABLE line makes a variable: a named place for a value that can change.

A name and a type follow the block. A literal may give the start value. Without one, the variable holds the default of its type. Arrays, hashes and structs get their start values in a code block.$(br2)A variable made inside a code block lives only inside that block. A variable at x=5 is global.
Craft a type base and a bone block, or turn a CONSTANT block into a VARIABLE block.
$(1)VARIABLE i INTEGER$(br)VARIABLE name STRING "Steve"$(br)VARIABLE list ARRAY INTEGER$(br)BEGIN$(br)  1 2 3$(br)END VARIABLE$()
